properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. @ajs, 2026-10-21, reading https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40169v1 ("Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution"; read through a summarizer, main text only): "yes, record (1) and (2) in reflow2 as ideas".

THE PAPER keeps three task sets apart: one where failures are found and changes are built (D_evo, 90 AppWorld tasks), one that chooses between candidates (D_val, 57), and one used only to report (D_test, held out). Skill libraries and memories built from D_evo are frozen during validation and test, so nothing leaks.

WHY IT APPLIES: reflow2's trials (the primes and logic proof rungs, the cogito and trolley arguments, the capstone, hxm_program's field reports) are used both to FIND friction and to show that the fix worked, often by re-running the same trial. A skill fixed against a trial and judged by that trial reads better than it is. This was measured once already on tool routing: 19 of 42 phrasings passed their corpus and failed a held-out paraphrase (fact:the-first-phrasings-passed-the-corpus-and-failed-the-held-out-paraphrases-19-of-42-were-tuned-not-written).

THE IDEA: name, per release, which trials found friction (tuning) and which judge (held out), and do not tune served text to a held-out trial before it is run. First use: step 6, the capstone demo (epoch:planned-demo-the-capstone), run on the new release with nothing tuned to it beforehand.

CHEAP / EXPENSIVE: cheap as a practice (a label on each trial run and a rule); a held-out trial is spent once used, so new ones are needed over time, which is the three-agent trial rule's "repeat on new concepts".

COUNTER-ARGUMENT: reflow2's trials are few and each is expensive; holding one back delays the friction it would find. And a single held-out run is one sample, not a measurement (idea (1) is the measured form).

OPTIONS, none chosen: (a) the practice and the label only; (b) the label plus a reflow2 reading that says when a verification's data also informed the design it verifies (the design-tool form, for every user's design); (c) leave it.
properties.name: OPEN — should the trials that find friction be kept apart from the check that judges the fix, so reflow2's skills are not tuned to the trials that judge them (the capstone demo as the first held-out check)?
